name: @pipeworx/mcp-nebraska-code

tools.name: ne_revised_statute
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Nebraska Revised Statutes — Nebraska state law — by citation. "Neb. Rev. Stat. 28-303" is first degree murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does Nebraska Revised Statute 28-303 say" or to check a Nebraska statute a case relies on.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nebraska-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nebraska-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
